image_description: A studio product shot of a white Logitech speaker system against a plain white background. The set includes a large, boxy subwoofer on the left with a prominent circular black grille and two smaller satellite speakers on the right. The front satellite speaker shows two distinct driver units (a larger mid-range/woofer and a smaller tweeter) stacked vertically. The rear satellite speaker is partially visible behind the front one.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The 'Logitech' logos are present but slightly soft and lack the crisp vector sharpness expected in a product render. The text is legible but shows minor edge bleeding typical of AI generation or low-res upscaling.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The bottom edge of the front satellite speaker appears to merge slightly with the white background without a distinct shadow line or clear base definition, creating a subtle 'floating' or melting effect at the contact point.
The perspective of the rear speaker is slightly ambiguous; the top curve seems to flatten unnaturally compared to the front speaker, though this could be due to occlusion.
